title: 酒店入住
goal: 听清退房时间，用一句英语确认。

listen.prompt: 前台说了一个时间。先听，再开口确认你听到的退房时间。
listen.en: Checkout is at eleven. If you need more time, just let us know.
listen.zh: 退房时间是 11 点。如果需要更多时间，告诉我们就好。

dialogue.speaker: other
dialogue.en: Good evening. How can I help you?
dialogue.zh: 晚上好，有什么可以帮您？

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.en: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Chen.

dialogue.speaker: other
dialogue.en: I found it. You're staying for two nights, right?

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.en: Yes, that's right. What time is checkout?

dialogue.speaker: other
dialogue.en: Checkout is at eleven in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 退房时间是上午十一点。

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，您是说十一点吗？

dialogue.speaker: other
dialogue.en: Yes, eleven. Here's your room key.
dialogue.zh: 是的，十一点。这是您的房卡。

phrases.en: Sorry, could you say that again?
phrases.zh: 不好意思，您能再说一遍吗？

passage.title: 我到了酒店
passage.en: I arrived at the hotel in the evening. I told the front desk my name and said I had a reservation for two nights. I asked what time checkout was. I didn't catch the time at first, so I asked again. The receptionist said eleven in the morning and gave me my room key.
passage.zh: 我晚上到了酒店。我告诉前台我的名字，说我预订了两晚。我问几点退房。我一开始没听清，就又问了一遍。前台说是上午十一点，然后给了我房卡。
passage.recall: 跟读一遍，收起短文，再按「到酒店 → 确认预订 → 问退房时间 → 拿到房卡」复述。

speak.prompt: 换到火车站。工作人员说站台改了，你没听清。先请对方重复，再确认是不是 5 号站台。
speak.sample: Sorry, could you say that again? Did you say platform five?
